info.title: tada
info.description: The tada HTTP API. The list of problem codes of each operation is open.

get.summary: Lists the events that the caller can see, in the order of their keys.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary: Creates an event in the caller's organization.
post.description:
If an event with the same `id` and the same content exists, the response is this event with the
status 200, and nothing changes.

200.description: The event exists with this ID and the same content.

get.summary: Reads one event. The caller needs an event role in it, or the organization role owner or admin.

post.summary: Creates a link code for the calling member.

get.summary: Lists the open link requests of the calling member.

post.summary: Confirms a link request. Only then does tada bind the Telegram account to the member.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The ID of the link request.

post.summary:
Asks for a magic link. The answer is the same for each address (ADR 0008).
Only a member gets a mail. Too many requests for one address or from one client get
`rate-limited` with `Retry-After` (ADR 0056).

202.description: The request is accepted. The body is empty.

post.summary:
Signs in with the token of a magic link. The token works once.
The response sets the session cookie.

200.description: The new session. The `Set-Cookie` header holds its token.

get.summary: Reads the session of the request. A session without an organization also gets its information.

post.summary: Chooses or changes the organization of the session (ADR 0056). The token stays the same.
Signs out: ends the session and clears the cookie. It also succeeds without a session.
Shows the organization and the role of an invitation. It does not use the token.

Accepts an invitation. The token works once. The response sets the cookie of a new session
in the organization of the invitation.

200.description: The new session. The `Set-Cookie` header holds its token.

get.summary:
Lists the event memberships of an event, with names and roles only.
Each member who can see the event reads them. Only event managers change them.

200.description: All event memberships of the event.

post.summary: Gives a member of the organization an event role. Only event managers can do this.

Changes the event role of a member. Only event managers can do this.
The only event manager of an event keeps the role: the change gives `invalid-transition`.

Removes the event role of a member. The member loses access to the event with the next request.
The only event manager of an event cannot be removed: this gives `invalid-transition`.

get.summary:
Lists the members of the organization, in the order of their display names.
Each member can read the list. Only owners and admins get the email addresses.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary: Removes a member from the organization, with all event memberships and API tokens of the member.
post.description:
Owners and admins remove members; only an owner removes an owner. Each member can leave.
The last owner and the only event manager of an event stay: this gives `invalid-transition`.
The member loses access with the next request.

get.summary: Lists the pending invitations, the oldest first. Only owners and admins see them.

post.summary: Invites a person into the organization. The worker sends the invitation mail.
post.description:
A pending invitation of the same email address is revoked. If an invitation with the same `id`
and the same content exists, the response is this invitation with the status 200.

200.description: The invitation exists with this ID and the same content.

post.summary:
Revokes a pending invitation. Its links stop working at once.
Only owners and admins can do this.

get.summary: Lists the documents of the event, the newest first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only the documents whose name contains this text, without regard to case.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary: Uploads a file as the first version of a new document in the event.
post.description:
The body is the raw file with the media type `application/octet-stream`, not a multipart form,
so that the server streams it to the object storage. The header `X-File-Name` holds the file
name, percent-encoded as UTF-8. The server detects the type from the content (ADR 0055).
The body can be as large as `TADA_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES`. The caller needs the event role
contributor or manager, or the organization role owner or admin (ADR 0052).

parameters.name: X-File-Name
parameters.description: The file name, percent-encoded as UTF-8.

requestBody.description: The raw file. Not a multipart form.

default.description: A problem (ADR 0037). An upload over the storage quota is `validation-failed` with the entry `quota-exceeded` on `/file`.

get.summary: Reads one document with its newest version.
Lists the versions of the document, in the order of their numbers.

post.summary: Uploads a file as a new version of the document. The older versions stay unchanged.
post.description: The body has the same form as for `upload_document`.

parameters.name: X-File-Name
parameters.description: The file name, percent-encoded as UTF-8.

requestBody.description: The raw file. Not a multipart form.

201.description: The document with the new version as its newest version.

default.description: A problem (ADR 0037). An upload over the storage quota is `validation-failed` with the entry `quota-exceeded` on `/file`.

get.summary: Downloads the file of a document version.
get.description:
The response has the media type that tada detected, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, a
`Content-Security-Policy` that allows nothing, and the file name in `Content-Disposition`
(RFC 6266). `disposition=inline` applies only to PDF and plain text (ADR 0009, ADR 0043).
A draft version has no file, so it is not found here; `RenderDocumentVersion` reads it.

parameters.name: version_id
parameters.description: The ID of the document version.

schema.description: How the browser handles a download.

200.description: The file. Its media type is the `media_type` of the version.

get.summary:
Reads a draft version with what the client needs to render it: the Markdown, the lint warnings and the target
of each `tada:` link for the caller. An upload version is not found here.

parameters.name: version_id
parameters.description: The ID of the draft version.

200.description: The draft version for the caller.

post.summary: Approves a draft version. Only an event manager approves (ADR 0052).
post.description:
The approved version never changes. The version that was approved before becomes `superseded`.
A version that is approved, superseded or archived, or older than the approved version, gives `invalid-transition`.

parameters.name: version_id
parameters.description: The ID of the draft version.

get.summary:
Compares two draft versions of the document: the lines, and the facts of their manifests.
A version that is not a draft version of this document is not found.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The ID of the older draft version.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The ID of the newer draft version.

get.summary: Reads the event profile. Each member who can read the event can read it.

Lists the field catalog of an event: the shipped fields and the fields of the event, in the order of their keys.
Each field has the JSON Schema of its values.

200.description: The field catalog of the event.

get.summary: Lists the changesets of an event with open proposals, oldest first. Only its event managers see them.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only `open` exists: the changesets with at least one open proposal.

schema.description: The filter of a list of changesets.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary:
Creates a changeset of proposals in an event, with the channel `web`.
Contributors and event managers can propose; a viewer gets `forbidden`.
post.description:
If a changeset with the same `id` and the same content exists, the response is this changeset with the
status 200, and nothing changes.

200.description: The changeset exists with this ID and the same content.

get.summary:
The Review Inbox: the changesets with open proposals that the caller can review, oldest first.
They are the changesets of each event that the caller manages and, for owners and admins,
the changesets of the organization, for example one that creates an event.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only `open` exists: the changesets with at least one open proposal.

schema.description: The filter of a list of changesets.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

get.summary:
Reads a changeset with each proposal, its evidence, its status and the current value of its target.
Only the reviewers of the changeset can read it.

post.summary:
Accepts the selected proposals and their dependencies, all or nothing (ADR 0050).
A changed target gives `record-version-conflict`, and the proposals concerned get the status `conflict`.
A selected proposal that is not open gives `invalid-transition`.

Rejects open proposals and the open proposals that depend on them.
A proposal that is not open gives `invalid-transition`.

get.summary:
Lists the API tokens of the member in this organization, the newest first.
The list holds the revoked and expired tokens, and never a secret.

post.summary: Creates an API token for an MCP client of the member (ADR 0045).
post.description:
The member must confirm the current notice with `notice_version_confirmed`.
A `propose` token needs the right to propose in an event.
If an owner switched off MCP tokens, or the member lacks the right to propose, the response is `forbidden`.
A client reads `GET /organization/features` to tell a switched-off MCP switch from a missing right.
The response holds the secret; the member sees it once.

201.description: The new token with its secret.

post.summary:
Revokes a token of the member. The token stops working with the next request.
A second revocation changes nothing.

get.summary:
Gives the version of the token notice (ADR 0045). The web client shows the text and sends the version
with `CreateToken` when the member confirms.
Lists the switches of the organization with their values. Each member can read them.

post.summary: Switches a feature of the organization on or off. Only an owner can do this.

200.description: The new value of the switch.

get.summary: Shows the privacy notice. Each member can read it.

post.summary: Replaces the privacy notice. Only an owner can do this.

get.summary:
Lists the persons of the organization in the order of their numbers.
The caller needs an event role in some event, or the organization role owner or admin.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only records whose name contains this text. Case, accents and extra spaces do not matter.

post.summary:
Creates a person. The caller needs the contributor or manager role in some event, or the
organization role owner or admin.

get.summary: Reads one person.

patch.summary:
Changes a person. Only an owner or an admin can do it.
A request with an old `expected_version` gets `record-version-conflict`.

get.summary:
Lists the institutions of the organization in the order of their numbers.
The caller needs an event role in some event, or the organization role owner or admin.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only records whose name contains this text. Case, accents and extra spaces do not matter.

post.summary:
Creates an institution. The caller needs the contributor or manager role in some event, or the
organization role owner or admin.

get.summary: Reads one institution.

patch.summary:
Changes an institution. Only an owner or an admin can do it.
A request with an old `expected_version` gets `record-version-conflict`.

get.summary: Lists the workstreams of an event, in the order of their names.

post.summary:
Creates a workstream in the event. Only event managers can do this.
A lead without the contributor or manager role gives `validation-failed` with the field code `unknown-member`.

patch.summary:
Renames a workstream, changes its lead or opens or closes it. Only event managers can do this.
A workstream of another event is not found.

get.summary: Lists the actions of an event in the order of their numbers. Each reader of the event can do it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: `me`, or the ID of a member: only the actions that this member owns.

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Only the actions of this workstream.

post.summary:
Creates an action. A contributor or manager of the event can do it.
An owner without the contributor or manager role gives `validation-failed` with the field code `unknown-member`.
A closed workstream gives the field code `closed`.

get.summary: Reads one action of the event.

patch.summary:
Changes an action. Its owner, the lead of its workstream or an event manager can do it.
A status that the current status cannot change to gives `invalid-transition`.

get.summary: Lists the commitments of an event in the order of their numbers. Each reader of the event can do it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: `me`, or the ID of a member: only the commitments that this member owns.

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Only the commitments of this workstream.

post.summary:
Creates a commitment. A contributor or manager of the event can do it.
A promisor that is not a person or institution of the organization gives the field code `unknown-record`.

get.summary: Reads one commitment of the event, with its evidence.

patch.summary:
Changes a commitment. Its owner, the lead of its workstream or an event manager can do it.
The status `firm` gives `invalid-transition`: only "make firm" makes a commitment firm.

post.summary:
Makes a conditional commitment firm. The people who change the commitment can do it.
The reason is mandatory; the condition stays as history (ADR 0068).

get.summary:
Lists the open actions and commitments that the caller owns.
It leaves out the events where the caller has no event role.

200.description: The open work of the caller.

owner_user_id.description: The member who owns the action: a contributor or manager of the event.

version.description: The record version. A change needs it.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

ActorKind.description: The kind of an author. The list of kinds is open.

user_id.description: A member of the caller's organization.

ApiToken.description: A token of the member. It never holds the secret.

notice_version.description: The version of the notice that the member confirmed when the member created the token.

last_used_at.description: The last time a client used the token. It is absent if no client used it.

revoked_at.description: The time of the revocation. It is absent for a token that is not revoked.

ApiTokenList.description: The tokens of the member. A member has few, so the list has one page.

edits.description:
The changes of the reviewer before the acceptance: the value of a proposal that sets a fact,
or fields of a proposal that creates an action, a commitment, a person or an institution.

items.description:
A change of the reviewer before the acceptance. A `set-fact` proposal takes `state`;
a proposal that creates an action, a commitment, a person or an institution takes `fields`.

fields.description: The fields of the new record that the reviewer replaces.

owner.description: The user ID of a contributor or a manager of the event.

workstream.description: An active workstream of the event.

state.description: The state and value that the reviewer accepts instead of the proposed one.

approximate.description: True for an approximate value, for example "about 20,000".

value.description:
A fact value. Its type must match the value type of the field.
The read tools give values in the same shape (ADR 0040).

oneOf.description:
A decimal number or range in the unit of the field, as text, for example `"20000"` or `"1.5"`.
A single value has `min` equal to `max`.
An amount or range in the minor unit of the currency of the field, for example 1500 for CHF 15.00.
A date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
A range of dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, with the meaning of its dates.
The keys of the choices.

value.description:
A fact value. Its type must match the value type of the field.
The read tools give values in the same shape (ADR 0040).

oneOf.description:
A decimal number or range in the unit of the field, as text, for example `"20000"` or `"1.5"`.
A single value has `min` equal to `max`.
An amount or range in the minor unit of the currency of the field, for example 1500 for CHF 15.00.
A date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
A range of dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, with the meaning of its dates.
The keys of the choices.

selected.description: The proposals to accept. tada adds the dependencies of each one that an earlier apply did not accept.

expected_version.description: The record version of the document that the caller read.

Author.description: Who created a record, for which member and through which channel (ADR 0039).

id.description: The user ID of a member or an AI client, or the ID of a service identity.

principal_id.description: The member for whom the author acts, if the author is not that member.

ChangeActionRequest.description:
The input of `ChangeAction`. An absent field stays as it is. `null` clears an optional field.
A request needs at least one field to change.

workstream_id.description: An active workstream of the event. A record keeps a workstream that closes later.

ChangeCommitmentRequest.description:
The input of `ChangeCommitment`. An absent field stays as it is. `null` clears an optional field.
The condition never changes. The status `firm` needs "make firm".

ChangeInstitutionRequest.description: The input of `ChangeInstitution`. An absent field stays as it is. `null` clears email or phone.

ChangePersonRequest.description: The input of `ChangePerson`. An absent field stays as it is. `null` clears email or phone.

ChangeWorkstreamRequest.description: The input of `ChangeWorkstream`. A field that is absent stays as it is.

Changeset.description: A changeset as a reviewer sees it.

event_id.description: The event of the changeset. It is absent for a changeset of the organization.

source_version_id.description: The source version that holds the text of the intake.

proposals.description: The proposals in the order of their IDs.

Channel.description: The way an author reached tada. The list of channels is open.

Choice.description: One choice of a choice field.

condition.description: The condition. It never changes, and it stays after the commitment becomes firm.

owner_user_id.description: The member who follows the commitment up: a contributor or manager of the event.

firm_reason.description: The reason that made the commitment firm. A commitment that started firm has none.

version.description: The record version. A change needs it.

evidence.description: The evidence of the accepted proposals that created or changed the commitment.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

CommitmentStatus.description: The status of a commitment. Only "make firm" changes a commitment to `firm`.

ConflictReason.description: Why a proposal conflicts. The list of reasons is open.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new action. A client that sends it can retry the request safely.

owner_user_id.description: A member with the contributor or manager role in the event.

workstream_id.description: An active workstream of the event.

allOf.description:
The input of `CreateChangeset`: the text of one intake and the proposals that it supports.
The event of the path is the event of each proposal.
The proposals have the shape of the MCP tools (ADR 0040).

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new changeset. A client that sends it can retry the request safely.

items.description: One proposal of a new changeset.

depends_on.description:
The proposals of the same changeset that must apply before this one,
for example the new field definition of a fact.

evidence.description: The passages of the source text that support the proposal. Each proposal has at least one.

items.description: A passage of a source version: a range of characters and its exact quote.

end.description: The offset after the last character.

page.description: The page of a PDF, from 1.

source_version_id.description:
The source version of the passage. Leave it out for the source text of the changeset.
Another source version must be readable in the event of the proposal and have a text,
for example a text file that a member uploaded to the event.

start.description: The offset of the first character.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the proposal. Other proposals of the changeset depend on it by this ID.

operation.description: The change that a proposal suggests.

oneOf.description: Create an event. Only a changeset without an event can create one.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new event.

key.description: Two to eight capital letters and digits, for example `FLY28`.

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone. The default is `Europe/Zurich`.

oneOf.description: Set the fact of a field in an event.

expected_version.description: The current version of the fact. Leave it out if the event has no fact of the field yet.

field_id.description: A field of the event catalog, or a new field of the same changeset.

state.description: The state of a fact. An unknown fact has no value.

approximate.description: True for an approximate value, for example "about 20,000".

value.description:
A fact value. Its type must match the value type of the field.
The read tools give values in the same shape (ADR 0040).

oneOf.description:
A decimal number or range in the unit of the field, as text, for example `"20000"` or `"1.5"`.
A single value has `min` equal to `max`.
An amount or range in the minor unit of the currency of the field, for example 1500 for CHF 15.00.
A date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
A range of dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, with the meaning of its dates.
The keys of the choices.

value.description:
A fact value. Its type must match the value type of the field.
The read tools give values in the same shape (ADR 0040).

oneOf.description:
A decimal number or range in the unit of the field, as text, for example `"20000"` or `"1.5"`.
A single value has `min` equal to `max`.
An amount or range in the minor unit of the currency of the field, for example 1500 for CHF 15.00.
A date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
A range of dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, with the meaning of its dates.
The keys of the choices.
Add a field definition to the field catalog of an event.

description.description: The meaning of the field, in English.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new field.

label.description: The German label that people see.

value_type.description: The value type of a new field. It never changes.

unit.description: The `snake_case` key of the unit, for example `person_per_day`.

granularity.description: Leave it out to accept each granularity.

multiple.description: True if a fact can hold several choices.

items.description: One choice of a new choice field.

label.description: The German label of the choice.

oneOf.description: Add a choice to a choice field of the event.

field_id.description: A field of the event, or a new field of the same changeset.

label.description: The German label of the choice.

oneOf.description: Close a field of the event for new facts.
Create an open question with its owner.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new open question.

owner.description: The user ID of the member who owns the question.

oneOf.description: Add a draft version to a document of the event (ADR 0051).
A new document of the event.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new document.

name.description: The name of the document, 1 to 200 characters.

oneOf.description: An existing document of the event.

expected_version.description: The current version of the document.

markdown.description:
CommonMark with tables, UTF-8, one sentence per line. No raw HTML and no images.
A fact is an empty link to an exact fact version: `[](tada:fact/<fact-uuid>?v=<n>)`.
Never write the value of a fact as text.
A source passage is a link with the supporting words: `[words](tada:source/<source-version-uuid>#<start>-<end>)`.
A `tada:` link writes each UUID in lowercase with hyphens. Other links use `https` or `mailto` only.
Each link must cite an accepted fact version, an assumption or an unknown of the event, never an open proposal,
or a source version that the member can see.
A number, date or amount outside a `tada:` link gives a lint warning for the reviewer.

oneOf.description:
Create a person of the organization. Search the persons first: propose a new one only if none matches.
A person belongs to no event, so the operation has no `event_id`.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new person.

oneOf.description:
Create an institution of the organization. Search the institutions first: propose a new one only if none matches.
An institution belongs to no event, so the operation has no `event_id`.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new institution.

institution_kind.description: `kind` names the operation, so the kind of the institution has this name.

oneOf.description: Create an action of the event. It starts `open`.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new action.

owner.description: The user ID of a member with the contributor or manager role in the event.

workstream.description: An active workstream of the event.

oneOf.description:
Create a commitment of the event. With a condition it starts `conditional`, else `firm`.
Never invent a signature or an approval: a commitment with an open condition stays conditional.

condition.description: The condition of the promise, 1 to 500 characters, for example "subject to a signed order".

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new commitment.

owner.description: The user ID of the member who follows the commitment up: a contributor or manager of the event.

promisor.description:
The person or institution that promises. It can be a new person or institution of the same changeset;
then the proposal depends on the proposal that creates it.

text.description: What the promisor promises, 1 to 500 characters.

workstream.description: An active workstream of the event.

oneOf.description: Change the status of an action of the event.

expected_version.description: The current version of the action.

oneOf.description: Set or clear the due date of an action of the event.

due_date.description: The new due date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Leave it out to clear the due date.

expected_version.description: The current version of the action.

oneOf.description:
Change the status of a commitment of the event.
`firm` means that the condition is met; the evidence must show it, for example the signed order.
The reason of the proposal becomes the reason of the firm commitment, so it has at most 500 characters.

expected_version.description: The current version of the commitment.

reason.description: A short reason for the proposal.

source_text.description:
The member's own words. tada stores them as a source version.
The passages count characters (Unicode scalar values) of this text after normalization: Unicode NFC with `\n` line ends.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new commitment. A client that sends it can retry the request safely.

condition.description: 1 to 500 characters. A commitment with a condition starts `conditional`, else `firm`.

owner_user_id.description: A member with the contributor or manager role in the event.

workstream_id.description: An active workstream of the event.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new event. A client that sends it can retry the request safely.

key.description: Two to eight capital letters and digits, unique in the organization.

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone. The default is `Europe/Zurich`.

user_id.description: A member of the caller's organization.

name.description: A name that helps the member to find the token again. tada removes the spaces at the ends and counts the characters (Unicode scalar values).

expires_at.description: The expiry. It is in the future and at most one year away.

notice_version_confirmed.description:
The version of the notice that the member confirmed: `GetTokenNotice` gives it.
Any other version than the current one, also a missing one, gives `validation-failed` with the code `not-confirmed`.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new workstream. A client that sends it can retry the request safely.

name.description: 1 to 200 characters, unique in the event whatever its case.

lead_user_id.description: A member with the contributor or manager role in the event.

CreatedApiToken.description: A new token with its secret.

secret.description: The secret of the token. It shows once, in this response.

event_id.description: The event of the changeset. It is absent for a changeset of the organization.

source_version_id.description: The source version that holds the text of the intake.

proposal_ids.description: The IDs of the proposals, in the order of their IDs.

CurrentFact.description: The current version of a fact.

value.description: The value. It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

approximate.description: True for an approximate value, for example "about 20,000". It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

Document.description: A document with its newest version.

readable_id.description: The readable ID, unique in the organization, for example `DOC-001`.

name.description: The file name of the first upload.

owner.description: The user ID of the member who created the document.

version.description: The record version. It increases with each new document version.

facts_changed.description:
True if the newest version cites an older version of a fact: the client shows „Fakten geändert“ (ADR 0051).
Only `get_document` gives it; it is absent in a list.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

DocumentVersion.description: One immutable version of a document.

number.description: 1 for the first version of the document, then 2, 3 and so on.

oneOf.description: The status of a draft. It is absent for an upload.

file_name.description: The file name of the upload, without control characters and path separators. It is absent for a draft.

media_type.description: The media type that tada detected from the content (ADR 0055). It is absent for a draft.

size_bytes.description: It is absent for a draft.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the content, as lowercase hexadecimal digits.

uploaded_by.description:
The user ID of the member who added the version: the member who uploaded the file, or for a draft,
the member who accepted its proposal.

source_version_id.description: The source version that holds the same file (ADR 0050). It is absent for a draft.

DocumentVersionKind.description:
The kind of a document version (ADR 0051).
The list of kinds is closed: the kind decides which fields a version has, so a client cannot show a version of a kind
that it does not know. A new kind needs a new ADR and a new version of the API (ADR 0017).

items.description: The versions in the order of their numbers.

DocumentVersionRendering.description: A draft version as the reader sees it.

oneOf.description: A new document of the event.
An existing document of the event.

expected_version.description: The record version of the document that the proposal expects.

DraftRendering.description:
A draft as the reader sees it (ADR 0051, ADR 0058). The client renders the Markdown and resolves each `tada:`
link from `links` only: a link without an entry shows „entfernt“. The server never formats a value.

markdown.description: The Markdown with LF line ends. Raw HTML in it is text.

lint_warnings.description: The warnings of the draft lint for the review. They do not block.

links.description: The target of each `tada:` link, by the exact text of its destination.

DraftVersionStatus.description:
The status of a draft version (ADR 0051).
The list of statuses is closed: they are the document states of the approval, and a client must know if a version
is approved. A new status needs a new ADR and a new version of the API (ADR 0017).

key.description: The short key of the event, unique in its organization, for example `FLY28`.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone of the event, for example `Europe/Zurich`.

version.description: The record version. A command that changes the event needs it.

EventMembership.description: The event role of one member in one event.

version.description: The record version. A command that changes the event membership needs it.

EventMembershipPage.description: The event memberships of an event. An event has few, so the list has one page.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

EventProfile.description: The event profile: the current facts of the event, its open fact proposals and its open questions.

facts.description:
The current version of each fact of the event, in the order of the field keys.
A field without a fact is absent. An unknown fact is present with the state `unknown`.

proposals.description: The fact proposals of the event without a review result, oldest first. They are not accepted state.

open_questions.description: The open questions of the event, in the order of their numbers.

EventRole.description: The role of a member in one event.

Excerpt.description: A passage with the text around it: at most 100 characters before and after it.

Fact.description: The current version of one fact.

field_key.description: The key of the field, for example `date_window`.

value.description: The value. It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

approximate.description: True for an approximate value, for example "about 20,000". It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

version.description: The number of the current fact version. A proposal that changes the fact expects it.

evidence.description: The passages of source versions that support the current fact version.

accepted_by.description: The reviewer who accepted the current fact version.

accepted_at.description: The time of the acceptance of the current fact version.

from.description: The fact version that the older draft version cites.

to.description: The fact version that the newer draft version cites.

FactDiff.description: The facts that the two manifests cite. If a version cites more than one version of a fact, the newest counts.

changed.description: The facts that both versions cite, each in another version.

added.description: The facts that only the newer version cites.

removed.description: The facts that only the older version cites.

FactEvidence.description: One evidence link: a passage of a source version.

captured_at.description: The time when tada captured the source version.

FactProposal.description: An open proposal that sets the fact of a field.

value.description: The proposed value. It is absent if the proposed state is `unknown`.

approximate.description: True for an approximate value, for example "about 20,000". It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

expected_version.description: The fact version that the proposal expects. It is absent if the field had no fact.

FactState.description: The status of a fact: `unknown` has no value (ADR 0049).

Field.description: A field definition of the field catalog.

value_schema.description: The JSON Schema of a value of this field: the `value` of a proposal that sets its fact.

description.description: The meaning of the field, in English.

module.description: The module of the field, for example `core`.

event_id.description: The event of a field that the event added. It is absent for a shipped field.

FieldPage.description: The field catalog of an event. It has few fields, so the list has one page.

FieldStatus.description: A deprecated field is readable, but takes no new facts.

Granularity.description: The meaning of the dates of a date window.

version.description: The record version. A change needs it.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

InvitationPage.description: The pending invitations. An organization has few, so the list has one page.

InvitationPreview.description: What an invitation is for, before the invitee accepts it.

organization_name.description: The name of the organization of the invitation.

privacy_notice.description:
The privacy notice of the organization in Markdown, or null if the template of the web client applies.
The invitee reads it before the acceptance (ADR 0045).

role.description: The role that the invitation gives.

InvitationTokenRequest.description:
The input of the invitation routes. Like the token of a magic link, the token of an invitation
reaches the server only in the body of a POST request (ADR 0008).

token.description: The token from the fragment of the invitation link.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new invitation. A client that sends it can retry the request safely.

role.description: An owner invites with any role; an admin with admin or member.

oneOf.description: The ID of a Fluent message of the web client, for example `field-date_window`.

Label.description: The label that people see: a Fluent message of a shipped field, or the German text of a field of an event.

LineChange.description: One line of the text difference.

old_line.description: The line number in the older version. It is absent for an added line.

new_line.description: The line number in the newer version. It is absent for a removed line.

text.description: The text of the line without its line end.

oneOf.description:
The exact fact version that the draft cites. The client marks an assumption with „Annahme“
and shows an unknown as „unbekannt“.

value.description: The value. It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

approximate.description: It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

oneOf.description: The cited passage of a source version.
The reader cannot see the target. The client shows „entfernt“.

LinkTarget.description: The target of a `tada:` link for the reader. `kind` names it. The list of kinds is open.

LintWarning.description: A warning of the draft lint on one line, from 1.

LintWarningKind.description: What the lint found outside a `tada:` link. The list of kinds is open.

reason.description: Why the condition is met: 1 to 500 characters. The commitment keeps it.

email.description: The email address. Only owners and admins get it.

version.description: The record version of the organization membership. `RemoveMember` needs it.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

MembershipSummary.description: A membership of the signed-in user.

event_key.description: The key of the event: with `local_id` it forms the full reference, for example `FLY28/ACT-042`.

MyAction.description: An action in "My Work", with the key of its event.

event_key.description: The key of the event: with `local_id` it forms the full reference, for example `FLY28/COM-003`.

MyCommitment.description: A commitment in "My Work", with the key of its event.

MyWork.description: The open work of the caller.

actions.description:
The actions with the status `open`, `in-progress` or `blocked`.
Due date first, a record without a due date last, then event key and readable ID.

commitments.description: The commitments with the status `conditional` or `firm`, in the same order.

review_count.description: The number of proposals that the caller reviews.

NewDocument.description: A new document with its readable ID.

NewLocalRecord.description: A new record with its readable ID.

local_id.description: The readable ID, for example `ACT-001`, `COM-001`, `PER-001` or `INS-001` (ADR 0038).

NewOpenQuestion.description: A new open question with its event-local ID.

event_id.description: The event of the changeset. It is absent for a changeset of the organization, for example one that creates an event.

open_proposals.description: The number of its open proposals.

stale.description: True if its open proposals are older than 14 days (ADR 0050). A stale proposal does not change.

OpenChangesetPage.description: One page of changesets with open proposals, oldest first.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

OpenQuestion.description: An open question of the event.

owner_id.description: The user ID of the member who owns the question.

value.description: The proposed value. It is absent if the proposed state is `unknown`.

approximate.description: True for an approximate value. It is absent if the proposed state is `unknown`.

expected_version.description: The fact version that the proposal expects. It is absent if the event had no fact of the field.

owner.description: The user ID of the member who owns the question.

oneOf.description: A new person of the organization. It belongs to no event.
A new institution of the organization. It belongs to no event.

institution_kind.description: `authority`, `company`, `club` or `other`. `kind` names the operation, so this field has another name.

oneOf.description: A new action of the event. It starts `open`.

owner.description: The user ID of the member who owns the action.

oneOf.description: A new commitment of the event. With a condition it starts `conditional`, else `firm`.

owner.description: The user ID of the member who follows the commitment up.

expected_version.description: The version of the action that the proposal expects.

due_date.description: The new due date. It is absent if the proposal clears the due date.

expected_version.description: The version of the action that the proposal expects.
The version of the commitment that the proposal expects.

Operation.description: The change that a proposal suggests. `kind` names the operation. The list of kinds is open.

OrganizationFeatureName.description: A switch of the organization. The list of features is open: a client ignores a feature that it does not know.

OrganizationRole.description: The role of a member in an organization.

Passage.description: A passage of a source version: a range of characters in its normalized text and the exact quote.

start.description: The offset of the first character, in Unicode scalar values.

end.description: The offset after the last character.

page.description: The page of a PDF, from 1.

user_id.description: The account of the person, if the person is a member.

version.description: The record version. A change needs it.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

PrivacyNotice.description: The privacy notice of the organization.

markdown.description: The Markdown text of the owner, or null if the template of the web client applies.

Problem.description: An error response. `detail` never repeats input values.

type.description: The URL of the code in the public catalog.

code.description: The stable problem code. Clients react to this field. The list of codes is open.

title.description: A short, stable English text for developers.

detail.description: An English text about this case, for developers. Clients never show it to members.

errors.description: The invalid values of a `validation-failed` problem.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the value in the request body, for example `/key`.

code.description: The reason, for example `taken`. The list of codes is open.

Promisor.description: The person or institution that makes a commitment.

PromisorInput.description: The promisor of a new commitment: a person or an institution of the organization.

Proposal.description: One proposal with its evidence, its status and the current value of its target.

depends_on.description: The proposals of the same changeset that must apply before this one.

reason.description: The short reason of the proposal.

evidence.description: The passages of the source text that support the proposal, each with the text around it.

stale.description: True if the proposal is open and older than 14 days (ADR 0050).

oneOf.description: Why the proposal conflicts, at the time of the read. It is present only if the status is `conflict`.
The current version of the fact that a `set-fact` proposal sets. It is absent if the event has no such fact.

A `create-document-draft` proposal as the reviewer sees it: its Markdown, its lint warnings and the target
of each `tada:` link. It is absent for each other operation.

ProposalEvidence.description: One passage of a source version, with the text around it.

source_version_id.description:
The source version of the passage: the source text of the changeset or another source version,
for example a text file of the event.

ProposalPromisor.description:
The party that makes a commitment: `{"person": "<uuid>"}` or `{"institution": "<uuid>"}`.
It can be a new person or institution of the same changeset.

ProposalStatus.description: The status of a proposal from its latest review result (ADR 0050). The list of values is open.

RecordEvidence.description: A passage that supports one version of a commitment.

record_version.description: The record version that the accepted change produced.

captured_at.description: The capture time of the source version.

RedeemMagicLinkRequest.description: The input of a sign-in with a magic link.

token.description: The token from the fragment of the magic link.

ReferenceTarget.description: The kind of record that a reference points to. The list of kinds is open.

proposal_ids.description: The open proposals to reject. tada also rejects the open proposals that depend on them.

ReviewResult.description: The proposals that a review changed, with their new status.

open_questions.description: The new open questions with their event-local IDs.

documents.description: The new documents with their organization-local IDs.

actions.description: The new actions with their event-local IDs.

commitments.description: The new commitments with their event-local IDs.

persons.description: The new persons with their organization-local IDs.

institutions.description: The new institutions with their organization-local IDs.

ReviewedProposal.description: A proposal with its new status.

SessionInfo.description: The signed-in user and the organization of the session.

oneOf.description: The organization of the session. It is absent until the member chooses one (ADR 0056).

memberships.description: All memberships of the user, in the order of the organization names.

markdown.description:
The new Markdown text, 1 to 20000 characters. Null gives the template back.
The field is required, so that a missing field cannot reset the text.

SignInRequest.description: The input of a sign-in request.

email.description: The email address of the member.

TelegramLinkCode.description: A new link code. The member sends it to the bot within ten minutes.

code.description: The code. It works once. The server shows it only in this response.

TelegramLinkRequest.description: A Telegram account that sent a code of the member, and that waits for the confirmation.

telegram_name.description: The name of the Telegram account, as Telegram sends it.

TelegramLinkRequestPage.description: The open link requests of the member. A member has few, so the list has one page.

TokenNotice.description: The version of the token notice. The text of the notice is part of the web client.

unit.description: The `snake_case` key of the unit, for example `person_per_day`.

oneOf.description: Absent if the field accepts each granularity.

multiple.description: True if a fact can hold several choices.

ValueType.description: The value type of a field, with its unit, currency or choices. The list of types is open.

VersionDiff.description: The difference between two draft versions of a document (ADR 0051).

lines.description: Each line of the two versions, in the order of the newer version, with the removed lines at their places.

lead_user_id.description: The member who leads the workstream: a contributor or manager of the event.

version.description: The record version. A command that changes the workstream needs it.

WorkstreamPage.description: The workstreams of an event. An event has few, so the list has one page.

WorkstreamStatus.description: The status of a workstream. A closed workstream accepts no new records.
